talents.name: Master Strike
descriptions:
Performs a skillful attack, dealing 35% weapon damage and causing an additional effect depending on your main hand weapon.

Mace: Disorients the target for 3 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.
Sword: Disarms the target for 3 sec.
Axe: Immobilizes the target for 4 sec.
Polearm: Deals an additional 100% weapon damage if the target is mounted and dismounts them.
Fist Weapon: Knocks down the target for 2 sec.
Staff: Increases your chance to parry by 25% for 10 sec.
Dagger: Silences the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Master of Arms
descriptions:

Axe - Increases your chance to get a critical strike by 1%.
Mace - Causes your attacks to ignore 1.2 of your target's Armor per level.
Sword - Gives you a 1% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target.
Polearm - Increases the range of melee attacks by 0.4 yd.

Adds the following effects to your weapons, based on the weapon type:

Axe - Increases your chance to get a critical strike by 2%.
Mace - Causes your attacks to ignore 2.4 of your target's Armor per level.
Sword - Gives you a 2% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target.

Adds the following effects to your weapons, based on the weapon type:

Axe - Increases your chance to get a critical strike by 3%.
Mace - Causes your attacks to ignore 3.6 of your target's Armor per level.
Sword - Gives you a 3% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target.
Polearm - Increases the range of melee attacks by 1.2 yd.

Adds the following effects to your weapons, based on the weapon type:

Axe - Increases your chance to get a critical strike by 4%.
Mace - Causes your attacks to ignore 4.8 of your target's Armor per level.
Sword - Gives you a 4% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target.
Polearm - Increases the range of melee attacks by 1.6 yd.

Adds the following effects to your weapons, based on the weapon type:

Axe - Increases your chance to get a critical strike by 5%.
Mace - Causes your attacks to ignore 6 of your target's Armor per level.
Sword - Gives you a 5% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after hitting your target.
Polearm - Increases the range of melee attacks by 2.0 yd.
